title: Tea, iced, brewed, green, pre-sweetened with low calorie sweetener

content.title: About
content.content: Iced brewed green tea sweetened with a low‑calorie sweetener – a refreshing beverage with minimal calories. The tea retains its characteristic grassy notes, while the sweetener adds a gentle sweetness without sugar.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green tea is rich in polyphenols, especially catechins, which have antioxidant properties.
Cold brewing preserves more of the beneficial compounds that can degrade with prolonged heat.
Low‑calorie sweeteners such as stevia or erythritol do not raise blood glucose levels.
Green tea has been consumed in Japan and China for over 3,000 years.
Iced tea is often served with a slice of lemon or lime to enhance flavor.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Catechins in green tea help neutralize free radicals, supporting cellular health.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Green tea extracts may boost fat oxidation and aid weight management.

items.title: Blood sugar regulation
items.content: Low‑calorie sweeteners do not cause rapid glucose spikes, beneficial for those at risk of diabetes.

items.title: Hydration without extra calories
items.content: Iced tea provides fluid and electrolytes without adding significant calories.

items.title: Improved focus
items.content: A modest amount of caffeine in green tea can enhance alertness and concentration without strong stimulation.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat even with small caffeine amounts.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Green tea extracts can amplify the effects of anticoagulants and certain blood‑pressure medications.

items.title: Allergy to sweetener
items.content: Rarely, people may have an allergic reaction to stevia or other low‑calorie sweeteners.

items.title: Overconsumption
items.content: Excessive intake of iced tea may lead to electrolyte imbalance or stomach irritation.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve the iced green tea chilled over ice, optionally adding a lemon wedge. It can also be used in cocktails, smoothies, or as a base for refreshing drinks.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared beverage in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 3‑5 days. Discard if the taste, smell, or appearance changes.
